command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'HOST='; hostname
for x in pactl parec pacat pw-record pw-play python3; do printf '%s=' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done
printf 'DEFAULT_SINK='; pactl get-default-sink 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'DEFAULT_SOURCE='; pactl get-default-source 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '---SERVER---'; pactl info 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,20p' || true
printf '%s\n' '---PY_IMPORTS---'; python3 - <<'PY'
mods=['sounddevice','numpy','scipy']
for m in mods:
    try:
        mod=__import__(m); print(m,'OK',getattr(mod,'__version__',''))
    except Exception as e:
        print(m,'NO',type(e).__name__,str(e)[:120])
PY
printf '%s\n' '---POCKET_CANDIDATES---'; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name 'activate' -o -name 'python' \) 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'pocket|tts|voice|frank' | head -80 || true
